items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the specified labels; p20 left and p300 right with the correct tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Log shows 12 aspirates of 100 uL from reservoir A1, each dispensed into plate A1 to A12 in order, using the p300; no other wells touched.
Log step 1 picks up a tip before any aspirate, and step 26 drops it at the end.
100 uL is within the p300 range; apiLevel 2.15 is valid; the simulation passed.
The protocol does exactly the single transfer requested; there are no false comments and the metadata is accurate.

judge.summary: The protocol transfers 100 uL from reservoir A1 to each of plate wells A1-A12 with the p300, as the run log confirms. It uses one tip that is dropped at the end, and all rubric items pass.
